judge_reasoning: The model's plan only produces 13 total attacking power spread across Rhonas (5/5 deathtouch+trample), Longtusk Cub (5/5 trample), and Greenbelt Rampager (3/4 trample), while incorrectly including Khenra Charioteer as an attacker despite summoning sickness (though its static trample-granting ability does still apply). Since only Rhonas has deathtouch, the opponent's three blockers (totaling 9 toughness) can block efficiently: using the weakest blocker on Rhonas (deathtouch trivializes toughness there) and bigger blockers on Cub and Rampager to stop most trample damage.
